# Review

> The literature review as a genre of the reader-ergonomics family: the five steps, the nine files, the grey score, the second rater and the flow, as shapes with examples and checks.

Each page's markdown source is served at the same path with a .md extension.

## Standard

- [Standard](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics-review/standard.md): the one-page card to follow, with every principle and its grade
- [Contributing](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics-review/AGENTS.md): rules for changing this repository

## Structure: what a review keeps

- [Five steps, in order](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics-review/principles/structure/five-steps-in-order.md): a review runs frame, review, state of the art, position and baseline in that order, and is finished when it can name the baseline it compares against.
- [The nine files](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics-review/principles/structure/the-nine-files.md): a review keeps frame, protocol, sources, review, against, state of the art, position, baseline and references, one role each, so that a reader and a program find a result where it is kept.

## Record: what a review lets a reader redo

- [Count every search](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics-review/principles/record/count-every-search.md): the protocol records every search string with its count, and says what was not searched, so that a reader can run the search again and compare.
- [Report the second rater](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics-review/principles/record/report-the-second-rater.md): when two raters score or screen the same items, the review reports how far they agree, and how a disagreement was settled.
- [Score grey sources in eight subtotals](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics-review/principles/record/score-grey-in-eight-subtotals.md): a grey source carries Garousi's eight subtotals and a total that adds up; below 10 of 20 it is an example of practice only, and says so.
- [Trace every figure](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics-review/principles/record/trace-every-figure.md): a figure in the review names its source and where it was read, or says it is secondary, so that a reader can find it.

## Optional

- [Evidence](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics-review/evidence/README.md): one literature review per topic, with the evidence against
- [Bibliography](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics-review/evidence/bibliography.md): every cited work, once
- [Shapes](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics-review/shapes/README.md): skeletons for kinds of documents
- [Checks](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics-review/checks/README.md): the programs that verify the standard
- [Decisions](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics-review/decisions/README.md): the choices this repository made, one record each
